chapter.verse: Tu-in Judea gam sunga om sawltakte leh sanggamte in Gentile mite zong Pasian' thu sang uh cih za uh hi.
Tua hangin Jerusalem ah Peter a pai ciangin vun-atte pawl in mawhsak uh a,
“Vun-atloh mite' kiang pai-in amau tawh an na nekhawm hi,” ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in a thu teng a banbanin gencian hi:
“Joppa khua ah thungenin ka om laitak, mumang bangin muhtuam khat ka nei a, vantung panin dial golpi tawh a kibang vanzat khat, a kiu lite pan hong kikhaisukin kei' kiang hong tungsuk hi.
Naitak ka et leh leilak-a gamta khelinei ganhingte, gamsate, bokvak awmtal ganhingte leh huihlak-a leng vasate ka mu hi.
Tua ciangin awging khat in, ‘Peter aw, tho inla go-in ne in,’ ci-a hong hopih ka za hi.
Ahih hangin kei'n, ‘Topa aw, ka ne peuhmah kei ding hi. A hang pen a thanghuai leh a sianglo peuhmah ka kam ah lut ngeilo hi,’ ka ci hi.
Himah taleh vantung pan awging in, ‘Pasian' siansaksa khat thanghuai ci kei in,’ ci-in a nihveina hong dawng hi.
Hih danin thumvei a pian khit ciangin a vekin vantung ah kikaitokik hi.
Tua hun lianin, en un, kei' kiangah hong kisawl Caesarea pan mi thum, ka omna uh innphual hong tung uh hi.
Tua banah, lunghiang lo-in amaute tawh tonkhop ding Kha in hong gen hi. Sanggamte guk in zong hong zui uh a, hong sampa' inn ka lut uh hi.
Inntekpa in a inn sungah vanmi hong ding a muhna thu leh, ‘Joppa ah mi sawl inla Peter ci-a kisam Simon samsak in.
Amah in nang leh na innkuanpihte na vekun hotkhiat na ngah nading uh thu hong pulak ding hi,’ ci-a a hopihna thu hong gen hi.
A masa lai-in Kha Siangtho eite' tung hong tun dan mahin thugen ka kipat ciangin amaute' tungah zong tung hi.
Kei zong Topa' genkhiat thu, ‘John in tui tawh hong baptize a, ahi zongin note pen Kha Siangtho tawh na kibaptize ding uh hi,’ a cih det ka phawk hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian in Topa Jesu Khris i up cianga hong piak deihguat thupha mah amaute zong pia ahihleh Pasian a khaktan zo dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?”
Hih thute a zak uh ciangin amaute in sel nawnlo uh hi. Tua ciangin, “Pasian in Gentile mite' tungah nuntakna a tunpih ding kisikna guan hi,” ci-in Pasian' min phat uh hi.
Tu-in Stephen' tunga piang bawlsiatna huhau-in a kithehthang mite Phoenicia, Cyprus, leh Antioch khuate dong ah tung uh a, Jew mite' kiang bek ah thu gen uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute' lakah Cyprus leh Cyrene mite kimkhat in Antioch a tun uh ciangin Hellenist-te hopihin Topa Jesu tawh kisai Lungdamna Thu tangko uh hi.
Topa' khut in amaute ompih a, mi tampitak in thu umin Topa' lamah kihei uh hi.
Hih thu a kigen, Jerusalem khua-a pawlpi in a zak ciangin amaute in Antioch ah Barnabas sawl uh hi.
Amah va tungin Pasian' hehpihna a muh ciangin lungdam a, amaute a vekun sawmna kician tawh Topa' tungah lungsim citaksuak ahih nadingun hanthawn hi.
A hang pen amah mihoih khat hi a, Kha Siangtho leh upna tawh a kidim khat ahi hi. Tua hi a, Topa' lamah mite a honin kibehlap hi.
Tua ciangin Saul a zong dingin Tarsus ah Barnabas pai hi.

Saul a muh ciangin Antioch ah paipihin tua takah a nihun pawlpi tawh kum khat sung bup kikhawl uh a, mihon a tamkhop khat' tungah thu hilh uh hi. Hih Antioch khua ah nungzuite Khristiante ci-in kilo masapen hi.
Tua sawngin kamsangte Jerusalem pan Antioch ah hong paisuk uh hi.
Tuate lakpan Agabus minnei khat hong ding a, leitung bup ah kialpi tung ding cih thu, Kha tungtawnin genkhol hi. (Hih kialpi pen Claudius' hun sungin tung hi.)
Tua ciangin nungzuite in amau' hihzawhzah ciat, Judea gam sunga sanggamte' kiangah cimawh huhna puak dingin khensat uh hi.
Tua mah bangin sem uh a, Barnabas leh Saul tungtawnin makaite' tungah huhna puak uh hi.
